zh-CN.Plywood thickness varies with sanding, m: 输入实际板材尺寸、锯缝、纹理方向和是否允许旋转。对个人项目来说，提前把这些参数设准，比开锯后返工更省时间。
zh-CN.The classic failure is cutting a 3/4 inc: 生成方案后不要只看利用率，还要检查窄条、余料、切割顺序和容易混淆的重复零件。可视化布局是开工前的最后审核点。
zh-CN.When parts stack, double tops, layered p: 把项目保存到历史记录，必要时导出 PDF 或打印切割清单。完成后对比实际余料，下次类似项目会规划得更准。
zh-CN.Measure the actual thickness with calipe: Measure the actual thickness with calipers and record it in your cut list before designing joinery. Treat the actual thickness as the real input, the nominal label as a rough name. When a project mixes sheets from different batches, check each, because a mid-project sheet swap can reintroduce the gap you measured away.
